ppi_focus: Scan for stored and pending codes. Check the ECU calibration ID against stock to detect a current or reverted tune.
Clutch engagement height and slip test in a high gear. Check for throwout-bearing noise with the pedal at rest and depressed.
Look for track wear: brake pad and rotor condition, tire shoulder wear, chewed-up rubber in the wheel wells, tow-hook marks.
Oil condition and level. If any track history surfaces, run a compression and leakdown test.
Underside and engine bay: check for oil leaks (cam-plug and front-cover areas) and that the intake, headers and exhaust are stock with CARB-legal parts.
Paint-meter all panels, especially the front bumper and hood, for accident repair.
Tire DOT dates, brand matching, and alignment wear pattern.
Confirm via VIN that no recall campaigns are open.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: VIN plus a clean history report with consistent mileage, and receipts showing regular oil service.
Up: a clean independent PPI confirming a stock ECU, healthy clutch and no track wear.
Up: a price negotiated toward the fair-value band of roughly $13k–$16k.
Down: any admission or evidence of track use, a past tune, an accident, or a branded title.
Down: the seller refusing the VIN or a PPI.
evidence.mission_note: A stock, naturally aspirated manual 86 within the ideal budget band fits the enthusiast-bridge brief directly: simple, cheap to run and easy to resell. That fit depends on proving no track or tune history.
evidence.rationale: The captured listing establishes a black 2017 Toyota 86 with a photo-confirmed manual transmission, a claimed clean title and about 57k claimed miles. The car is in Atwater, CA, roughly two hours from Carmel. The four photos show a clean exterior with stock-appearing wheels, ride height, wing and exhaust tips, plus a tidy cloth interior, which loosely supports the 'completely stock' claim. Nothing is observed wrong in the photos. The asking price of $18,500 sits above the $11,664–$15,751 fair-value band derived from BRZ/FR-S sold comps, though dealer peers are asking more. Still open: the VIN, owner count, service records, accident history, tire dates, clutch condition, track history and ECU status. Our capture of the detail page was incomplete, so some of this may exist in the full listing.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN and an exact odometer photo, and ask directly about track use and ECU tuning; then run a history report and book an independent PPI near Atwater before any deposit.
